text: This report provides information on the status of the Exhibition Place health and safety system, specifically on activities, priorities, and performance during the third quarter of 2023. There were 0 lost time injuries and 1 medical aid injury in the third quarter of 2023, a decrease from 1 lost time injury and 2 medical aid injuries during the same period in 2022. Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) invoiced costs for the third quarter of 2023 were 88 percent higher than in the third quarter of 2022. An increase in Long Term Disability costs and claim costs are attributable to the higher WSIB fees.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (November 30, 2023) from the Chief Financial Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
